statement: ROOT reports Gaeta 2025 main lines 37--812: prepared 25 um steel, sanding, laser cutting, encapsulation and four glued EPMs. The 50 mJ/pulse is calculated rather than a whole-system meter. Levine 2025 main 170--206 shows compliance, roughness and separation affect capacity/switchability; Coulomb pressure alone is insufficient. Its followup at 207 timed out and is held.
